SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_t >= 1857 - 7
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 1) as avg_water_temp_c,
  COUNT(*) as readings
FROM pier
WHERE ts_t >= 1857 - 7
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  report_date_doy,
  yt_local,
  yt_all,
  text
FROM fishdope
WHERE report_date_doy >= 25
ORDER BY report_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
  report_date_season,
  report_date_doy,
  yt_local,
  yt_all
FROM fishdope
WHERE report_date_season = 6
ORDER BY report_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 10;
